project_info.theme: Toyota Vios technology and finance offer
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, white, champagne gold, gray, black

main_subject.detail: A showroom-style car-sales poster with the Toyota logo at top left and huge gold-white text reading 'VUNG CONG NGHE TRON AN TAM'. Two white Toyota Vios sedans are parked side by side on a clean urban plaza. Bottom gold panels list the offers: 'HO TRO 50% LE PHI TRUOC BA', 'UU DAI LAI SUAT 7.49%/NAM', and 'TRA TRUOC 0 DONG'. The background combines a blue city skyline on the left and modern architectural columns on the right. Bottom-right script reads 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Premium automotive sales poster with glossy sedan renderings, urban-modern backdrop, and gold finance-offer badges

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Vios technology and finance offer. Centerpiece is a pair of white Toyota Vios sedans parked on a clean urban plaza. Background is a modern city setting with blue skyline towers on the left and minimal architecture on the right. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact headline 'VUNG CONG NGHE TRON AN TAM', and gold offer plates reading 'HO TRO 50% LE PHI TRUOC BA', 'UU DAI LAI SUAT 7.49%/NAM', and 'TRA TRUOC 0 DONG', plus the script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal automotive advertising composite with sales-poster retouching, bright automotive commercial lighting, clean reflections and metallic highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
